record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, Altaschith<WH0516><WTH8686>, Michtam<WH04387> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Do ye indeed<WH0552> speak<WH01696><WTH8762> righteousness<WH06664>, O congregation<WH0482>? do ye judge<WH08199><WTH8799> uprightly<WH04339>, O ye sons<WH01121> of men<WH0120>? <RF>Altaschith...: or, Destroy not<Rf> <RF>Michtam: or, A golden Psalm<Rf>
Yea, in heart<WH03820> ye work<WH06466><WTH8799> wickedness<WH05766>; ye weigh<WH06424><WTH8762> the violence<WH02555> of your hands<WH03027> in the earth<WH0776>.

The wicked<WH07563> are estranged<WH02114><WTH8804> from the womb<WH07358>: they go astray<WH08582><WTH8804> as soon as they be born<WH0990>, speaking<WH01696><WTH8802> lies<WH03577>. <RF>as soon...: Heb. from the belly<Rf>

Their poison<WH02534> <FI>is<Fi> like<WH01823> the poison<WH02534> of a serpent<WH05175>: <FI>they are<Fi> like the deaf<WH02795> adder<WH06620> <FI>that<Fi> stoppeth<WH0331><WTH8686> her ear<WH0241>; <RF>like the poison: Heb. according to the likeness, etc<Rf> <RF>adder: or, asp<Rf>

Which will not hearken<WH08085><WTH8799> to the voice<WH06963> of charmers<WH03907><WTH8764>, charming<WH02266><WTH8802><WH02267> never so wisely<WH02449><WTH8794>. <RF>charming...: or, be the charmer never so cunning<Rf><CM>
Break<WH02040><WTH8798> their teeth<WH08127>, O God<WH0430>, in their mouth<WH06310>: break out<WH05422><WTH8800> the great teeth<WH04459> of the young lions<WH03715>, O LORD<WH03068>.

Let them melt away<WH03988><WTH8735> as waters<WH04325> <FI>which<Fi> run continually<WH01980><WTH8691>: <FI>when<Fi> he bendeth<WH01869><WTH8799> <FI>his bow to shoot<Fi> his arrows<WH02671>, let them be as cut in pieces<WH04135><WTH8709>.

As a snail<WH07642> <FI>which<Fi> melteth<WH08557>, let <FI>every one of them<Fi> pass away<WH01980><WTH8799>: <FI>like<Fi> the untimely birth<WH05309> of a woman<WH0802>, <FI>that<Fi> they may not see<WH02372><WTH8804> the sun<WH08121>.

Before your pots<WH05518> can feel<WH0995><WTH8799> the thorns<WH0329>, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind<WH08175><WTH8799>, both living<WH02416>, and in <FI>his<Fi> wrath<WH02740>. <RF>both...: Heb. as living as wrath<Rf>

The righteous<WH06662> shall rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> when he seeth<WH02372><WTH8804> the vengeance<WH05359>: he shall wash<WH07364><WTH8799> his feet<WH06471> in the blood<WH01818> of the wicked<WH07563>.

So that a man<WH0120> shall say<WH0559><WTH8799>, Verily <FI>there is<Fi> a reward<WH06529> for the righteous<WH06662>: verily he is<WH03426> a God<WH0430> that judgeth<WH08199><WTH8802> in the earth<WH0776>. <RF>a reward...: Heb. fruit of the, etc<Rf><CM>
